changelog:
connect-apps 0.1.0 – Initial release

- New skill enabling Claude to connect to external apps (e.g. Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, and 1000+ more) through Composio Tool Router.
- Allows sending emails, creating GitHub issues, posting to Slack, updating Notion, and more directly from Claude.
- Step-by-step setup instructions for installation and app authorization.
- Clear troubleshooting tips for common issues.
- Lists major supported app categories (Email, Chat, Dev, Docs, Data).
- Includes example prompts to demonstrate key capabilities.
